title: Paint Calculator
metaDescription: Estimate interior wall and ceiling paint in gallons from room size, doors, windows, and coats, then split the wall paint into 5-gallon, gallon, and quart cans.
secondaryKeywords: how much paint do i need
how many gallons of paint do i need
how much does a gallon of paint cover
intent: Estimate gallons of paint for a room's walls and ceiling, given dimensions, openings, coats, and the product's coverage rate.
registerRow: Keyword Register (estimates): paint calculator — volume 4, competition ease 2, ad value 3, fit 5, priority 24
intro: Estimate how many gallons of interior paint a room needs, with the walls and the ceiling as separate buys, then turn the wall paint into 5-gallon buckets, gallon cans, and quarts. Coverage starts at 350 square feet per gallon from the Sherwin-Williams SuperPaint data sheet.
uniqueAddition: A SuperPaint coverage selector (350 or 400 sq ft per gallon from the cited data sheet, or a custom rate) plus a shopping list that keeps wall paint, ceiling paint, and primer separate. Wall paint is split into 5-gallon buckets, 1-gallon cans, and quarts (rounded up to the next quart; three leftover quarts become one more gallon). The donut shows the gallons to buy of each product. page.md adds a wall-and-ceiling shopping table for six common room sizes at 2 coats and 350 sq ft per gallon.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: Room length
inputs.help: 4 to 50 ft. Measure the floor along one wall.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Room width
inputs.help: 4 to 50 ft. Measure the floor along the next wall.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Wall height
inputs.help: 7 to 12 ft. Floor to ceiling, not just to the top of the window trim.

inputs.name: includeCeiling
inputs.label: Include ceiling
inputs.help: Yes figures the ceiling (length times width) as its own buy, because ceilings usually get a separate ceiling paint. It never changes the wall paint or wall cans.

inputs.name: doors
inputs.label: Doors
inputs.help: Whole number, 0 to 10. Count openings you will not paint with the wall color.

inputs.name: windows
inputs.label: Windows
inputs.help: Whole number, 0 to 20. Count openings you will not paint with the wall color.

inputs.name: coats
inputs.label: Coats
inputs.help: Whole number, 1 to 3. SuperPaint's data sheet calls for 2 coats on drywall.

inputs.name: product
inputs.label: Product
inputs.help: Sherwin-Williams SuperPaint Interior Latex Flat lists 350–400 sq ft per gallon at 4 mils wet. 350 is the low end and the default; 400 is the high end. Those two choices lock that rate. Custom uses the coverage box.

inputs.name: coverage
inputs.label: Coverage rate
inputs.help: 200 to 450. Used only when Product is Custom. Read the number off your can's data sheet.

inputs.name: doorSize
inputs.label: Door size
inputs.help: 10 to 40 sq ft each. Starts at 20, a 36 in by 80 in door (3 ft by 6 ft 8 in). JELD-WEN lists 6 ft 8 in as a standard interior height. Measure yours if it differs.

inputs.name: windowSize
inputs.label: Window size
inputs.help: 4 to 40 sq ft each. Starts at 15, the nominal 36 in by 60 in call size. A JELD-WEN Builders vinyl double-hung in that call size has a 35.5 in by 59.5 in frame (about 14.7 sq ft). Measure the opening.

inputs.name: includePrimer
inputs.label: Include primer
inputs.help: Yes adds one primer coat over the walls and, if included, the ceiling, at the same coverage rate as the paint. Primer is a separate buy. The data sheet suggests primer for a big color change or new drywall.
